==Biography==
Brandon Joel Villegas is from Hurlingham, Buenos Aires, Argentina.

== Trivia ==
* His ID comes from his brother since he came up with the name "José" randomly.
* He started playing when he was 12 years old on the recommendation of his best friend. At first he didn't like the game but then he started playing for fun.
* He's known by his friends and fans as "only Lee Sin".
* At first he played as Mid because he liked to play 1vs1 using champions like {{ci|Lee Sin}}, {{ci|Jayce}}, and {{ci|Kha'Zix}}. He started playing in the Jungle so he could Play {{ci|Lee Sin}} since the champion always got banned when he played mid.
* One of the "players to watch" in 2018.
* After [[Oddie]]'s first retirement, analysts and some esports personalities considered him the best jungler in the LATAM scene.
* Became the first Latin American player to be imported to a major region league, after joining [[FlyQuest]] in the [[LCS]].
* He likes to play basketball and soccer.
* His favorite musical genres are Electronic and Rock.
* He likes to watch the [[LoL Pro League|LPL]].
* Has reached Rank 1 on NA, BR and LAS.
* Ended Season 7 as Top 1 Challenger on the BR server.
* Reached Top 2 Challenger on NA Server in Season 10.
* Reached Challenger on China's Super Server before Worlds 2020 Play-In stage began.
* Reached Top 1 Challenger on NA Server in Season 11.
* Reached Challenger on KR Server during the Season 12 preseason.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LLA Most Improved Player (Closing 2020)
